catalog.summary: Scrolling log of messages that follows new ones.

patternAbsent.reason: There is no Authoring Practices pattern for a conversation. The rows are a WAI-ARIA `log`, which announces what is added; the Feed Pattern is the closest pattern and its `PageUp`/`PageDown` between articles is not taken, because in a focusable scroll region those keys scroll natively.

roles.root: none; the positioning context of the jump control
roles.separator: none; its text is read in the flow
roles.unread: none; its text is read in the flow

engine.overflowAnchorReason: Safari has no native scroll anchoring, and in Chrome a native correction added to the engine's own moves the reader twice. The engine keeps the first visible row where it was, on every prepend and every size change above it.
engine.anchor: a row appended with `anchor` is brought to scrollMargin + peek below the top; the room it needs below is --slotted-message-scroller-room, which shrinks as the reply grows
engine.reducedMotion: behavior smooth becomes auto under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce
engine.hotPath: the engine writes the runtime attributes and the room property itself; a binding re-renders only the jump control

reachStart.reason: The reader reached the top: the moment to ask for older messages. It fires once per arrival.

anchorChange.carries: the id of the current anchored turn, or null

scrollableChange.carries: { start, end }: the edges the viewport can still scroll toward

commands.scrollToMessage: (id, { align: start | center | end | nearest, behavior, highlight }) => boolean
commands.scrollToEnd: ({ behavior }) => boolean; resumes following when follow is on
commands.highlight: the landed row carries data-current for 1600 ms, then loses it; the fade out is the stylesheet's, on --slotted-duration-long

jump.family: button › iconButton, size sm, shape circle, variant outline
jump.glyph: arrow-left, turned to point along its direction
jump.reason: The count answers the shadcn documentation's own eighth principle — show what is happening out of view — which its button does not.

separator.sticky: stays at the top of the viewport while the rows after it are in view
separator.family: the rule is drawn like divider's labelled rule

keyboard.effect: reaches the viewport, then the targets inside the rows, then the jump control when it is active
scrolls the focused viewport up and releases following
scrolls one page up and releases following

virtualization.reason: Rows stay in the DOM for selection, find in page and assistive technology, and `content-visibility: auto` skips the painting of rows far from view. A transcript of tens of thousands of rows hands the viewport to a virtualizer: the viewport part is the scroll element.

feedKeys.reason: `PageUp` and `PageDown` scroll a focused scroll region natively; taking them to move between articles would take scrolling from a keyboard reader.

composer.reason: The field below a conversation is `prompt-composer`, a Specialized family not built yet.
